name: week
title: Weekly customer advocacy desk
subtitle: Internal records. Nothing sends from this view.

sections.title: Reference queue
sections.sql: select code,prospect,kind,due_date,owner,status,advocate,assignment_status from request_queue order by due_date

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select record,reason,owner from attention order by reason,record

sections.title: Workload
sections.sql: select name,company,status,load,capacity,last_completed,last_activity from advocate_load order by name

sections.title: Permissions
sections.sql: select a.name,p.kind,p.decision,p.valid_until,p.restrictions from current_permissions p join advocates a on a.id=p.advocate_id order by a.name,p.kind

name: compliance
title: Privacy and record checks
subtitle: Record checks for a human review. These are not a legal compliance certificate.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select record,rule,finding,owner from compliance_findings order by rule,record

sections.title: Story clearance
sections.sql: select title,name,company,status,usable,valid_until from story_library order by title
